name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as shown in the logs

service.title: Service
service.description: The HomeKit service of each zone's Sonos and Speakers services, and so its volume characteristic

brightness.title: Volume as Brightness
brightness.description: Show the volume as Brightness rather than Volume, for a Switch or Speaker service

speakers.title: Speakers service
speakers.description: Add a Speakers service per zone for the zone itself: its volume, balance, bass, treble and loudness, and joining or leaving a group

leds.title: LEDs
leds.description: Add a Lightbulb for each player's LED and button lock, and an accessory for each stereo pair's other player, sub and surround

heartrate.title: LED poll interval (seconds)
heartrate.description: Read the LEDs and button locks every so many seconds rather than at each read from HomeKit

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.description: Add a switch for each Sonos alarm to its zone's accessory

tv.title: TV accessories
tv.description: Add a Television accessory per zone, published on its own, whose inputs are the household's Sonos favourites

maxFavourites.title: Inputs per TV
maxFavourites.description: The number of input sources on each TV accessory (16 to 96)

tvIdPrefix.title: TV id prefix
tvIdPrefix.description: Replaces RINCON in the TV accessories' ids, so two bridges on one network do not collide

excludeAirPlay.title: Leave out AirPlay players
excludeAirPlay.description: Do not add zones (nor TVs) for players that support AirPlay 2, which the Home app shows already

mdns.title: mDNS discovery
mdns.description: Also find the players over mDNS (Bonjour), beside SSDP

port.title: Event port
port.description: The TCP port the players send their events to; 0 lets the system choose (a port of 1024 or less is taken as 0)

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long a request to a player may take, and the wait for a subscription's first event

subscriptionTimeout.title: Subscription duration (minutes)
subscriptionTimeout.description: How long each event subscription lasts before it is renewed

resetTimeout.title: Reset timeout (milliseconds)
resetTimeout.description: After how long Volume Change, Track Change, Input Change and refused writes are put back
